scene.label: Act 2, Scene 3
scene.title: SCENE III. A street near the Capitol.

lines.text: "Caesar, beware of Brutus; take heed of Cassius; come not near Casca; have an eye to Cinna; trust not Trebonius; mark well Metellus Cimber; Decius Brutus loves thee not; thou hast wrong'd Caius Ligarius. There is but one mind in all these men, and it is bent against Caesar. If thou be'st not immortal, look about you: security gives way to conspiracy. The mighty gods defend thee!

lines.text: Here will I stand till Caesar pass along,
lines.plainText: Here will I stand till Caesar pass along

lines.text: And as a suitor will I give him this.
lines.plainText: And as a suitor will I give him this

lines.text: My heart laments that virtue cannot live
lines.plainText: My heart laments that virtue cannot live

lines.text: Out of the teeth of emulation.
lines.plainText: Out of the teeth of emulation

lines.text: If thou read this, O Caesar, thou mayest live;
lines.plainText: If thou read this O Caesar thou mayest live

lines.text: If not, the Fates with traitors do contrive.
